correctness.rationale: For the printed vector field the Jacobian characteristic polynomial is \((\lambda+c)[\lambda^3+(b-a)\lambda^2+(1-ab)\lambda+(b-a)]\). At \(a=0\) this factors as \((\lambda+c)(\lambda+b)(\lambda^2+1)\), giving \(\{-c,-b,i,-i\}\) and excluding a zero eigenvalue. Implicit differentiation of the critical root gives \(\operatorname{Re}\lambda'(0)=b^2/[2(1+b^2)]\), hence \(729/1460>0\) at \(b=27\). Reconstruction of the quadratic Hopf coefficient with the package normalization gives \(l_1=-58491/724744000<0\), so the crossing is an ordinary nondegenerate supercritical Hopf bifurcation and the stable small periodic branch lies for \(a>0\). The separate zero-Hopf spectral condition is \(a=b\in(0,1)\). A fresh exact rational replay independently reproduced the crossing derivative and Lyapunov coefficient.
